content.content:
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An optional Idempotency-Key header makes create safe to retry: a repeat of an already-seen key
# short-circuits to the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate. Runs first,
# before the duplicate/quota checks, so a retry never 409s.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  outputs:
    proceed: validate
    existing: loadExisting

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagBulkSignup

flagBulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: respondExisting

respondExisting:

composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An optional Idempotency-Key header makes create safe to retry: a repeat of an already-seen key
# short-circuits to the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate. Runs first,
# before the duplicate/quota checks, so a retry never 409s.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  outputs:
    proceed: validate
    existing: loadExisting

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagBulkSignup

flagBulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

# Repeat of an already-seen Idempotency-Key: load and return the originally created owner with 200.
loadExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadExistingOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: respondExisting

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithExistingOwner

content.text:
The full suite is green. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## What the change does

Per the spec, a new owner's `membershipLevel` is now capped at **one above the current maximum `membershipLevel` among their existing household members** (owners sharing the same deterministic `householdId`, derived from normalized lastName + postcode). With no existing household member, no cap applies.

## Changes made

1. **`OwnerMembership.level()`** — after banding points into a level, applies the owner's stored `membershipLevelCap` (`min(level, cap)`); a null cap leaves the level unchanged.

2. **New `CapMembershipLevel` function** — computes the cap at create time: the max level among existing household members `+ 1`, or leaves it null when the household has no prior member. It runs after `AssignHouseholdId` (needs `householdId`) and before `SaveOwner` (so `findAll()` returns only predecessors), mirroring the existing `AssignHouseholdId`/`CountNamesakes` pattern.

3. **`Owner` entity + all four `schema.sql` files** — added the persisted `membership_level_cap` column, so the capped level is reflected on later `GET`s (consistent with how `householdSize`/`namesakeCount` are stored).

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the `capMembershipLevel` step into the pipeline under `transaction` governance.

5. **`EnsureIdentityUnique`** — the feature requires households with multiple members, but this duplicate check was rejecting *any* second owner in an existing household. I aligned it with `OwnerIdentity`'s documented single-source-of-truth ("two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal; same-household owners with different telephones are both allowed"), so it now blocks on an exact full `identityKey` match rather than household alone. This is what lets a household legitimately hold more than one member.

The `AcceptanceTest.coreCapsLevelByHousehold` test (and the full suite) passes; the audit log confirms two same-household owners now create successfully at levels 1 and 2.
